dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」

公園の出口に向かう途中で、なにやら上のほう
を見上げている美春を見つける。
dialogues.en:
On my way to the park exit, I catch a glimpse of Miharu
looking up at something.
dialogues.text:
On my way to the park exit, I catch a glimpse of Miharu
looking up at something.

dialogues.jp: （あいつ何やってんだ？）
「おい美春」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「わわっ」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、朝倉先輩おどかさないでくださいよ」

俺と気付き胸をなでおろす美春――ホントに胸
を撫で下ろしてるよ――。
dialogues.en:
Shocked by my appearance, she had her hands on her chest;
although more accurately, she was brushing downwards on it--
dialogues.text:
Shocked by my appearance, she had her hands on her chest;
although more accurately, she was brushing downwards on it--

dialogues.jp: 「脅かすなって言われてもな……」

声をかける側からすると、国家試験よりも難し
い。
dialogues.en:
If I wanted to threaten her, I'd have said something more
like "The state exams are difficult" or something...
dialogues.text:
If I wanted to threaten her, I'd have said something more
like "The state exams are difficult" or something...

dialogues.jp: 「おまえ、なんで制服なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you wearing your school uniform?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you wearing your school uniform?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、委員会のお仕事があったんですよ♪」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I was in a committee meeting earlier♪"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I was in a committee meeting earlier♪"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……面倒だな」
ぽりぽり、と頭をかいてやはり首をかしげる。
dialogues.en:
I raised my head upwards, stretching my neck with "crick"
sounds.
dialogues.text:
I raised my head upwards, stretching my neck with "crick"
sounds.

dialogues.jp: 「で、なにしてんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「それが大変なんですよ」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「バナナがなくなったか？」
dialogues.en: "Bananas disappeared off the face of the earth?"
dialogues.text: "Bananas disappeared off the face of the earth?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなんじゃありません。バナナは永遠に不
　滅です！」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうじゃなくてあれですよ、あれっ！」

美春がぐいぐいと腕を伸ばして指し示す方を見
上げる。
dialogues.en: My eyes follow Miharu's pointed finger.
dialogues.text: My eyes follow Miharu's pointed finger.

dialogues.jp: 美春の指す目の前の木を見上げる。
dialogues.en: What my eyes saw was the top of a tree.
dialogues.text: What my eyes saw was the top of a tree.

dialogues.jp: 木の枝に、一匹の猫がしがみついていた。
dialogues.en:
A shivering cat was standing furtively on one of the
branches.
dialogues.text:
A shivering cat was standing furtively on one of the
branches.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「きっと降りられないんですよ」
dialogues.en: "It definitely won't be able to come down by itself..."
dialogues.text: "It definitely won't be able to come down by itself..."

dialogues.jp: 確かに｛おび／怯｝えているように見えるが……。
dialogues.en: It must be scared half-to-death as well.
dialogues.text: It must be scared half-to-death as well.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、助けてあげましょうよ〜」
◆猫を発見した美春◆

美春が、木から降りられなくなった猫を見つけ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
Miharu found a cat perched on a tree branch, unable to come
down.
dialogues.text:
Miharu found a cat perched on a tree branch, unable to come
down.

dialogues.jp:
助けて上げようと、美春は俺に頼んでくるのだ
が……。
dialogues.en: Miharu pleaded me to go up there and rescue it...
dialogues.text: Miharu pleaded me to go up there and rescue it...
